title: Local Vault IPC
responsibility: Restricts Vault installer status and write actions to the trusted top frame of the local Harness Mac window.

outputs.name: vaultSetupIpc
outputs.description: Registers IPC handlers for Vault status and fixed setup or remove actions. Untrusted callers and unknown actions receive an error without starting the installer.

errors.name: unsupported
errors.description: Status is unsupported for callers outside the trusted local macOS window.

errors.name: Operation refused
errors.description: A mutation returns a reason if the caller is untrusted or the action is unknown.
